metadata.cohort_description: Step 0c cohort: held-out test transactions with deployed score >= t_review (N=1,699, matched seed 42)
metadata.pre_specified_decision_rule: Cross-strategy agreement is concluded to differ from retraining noise IF AND ONLY IF the 95% bootstrap interval of between-strategy overlap lies strictly below the within-strategy retraining noise interval.

within_strategy_retraining_noise_decompo.description: Decomposed into model-seed-only variation (fixed subsample draw, seeds 4201..4210) and multi-set data-draw variation (seeds 42..51 across 10 sets)

pre_specified_conclusion.verdict: evidence of strategy-induced explanation shift beyond retraining noise
pre_specified_conclusion.interpretation: For all strategy pairs, between-strategy overlap (95% bootstrap CIs: [0.8219, 0.8346], [0.7868, 0.7987], [0.7965, 0.8075]) lies strictly below the within-strategy retraining noise interval [0.8379, 0.8713]. Consequently, there is statistically significant evidence that imbalance-handling strategies induce an attribution shift exceeding retraining noise.
